_note: The default span-of-control band, used for any role that doesn't match one of the work-archetype rules in span-archetypes.json (the 'professional / knowledge work' case, per the B1 skill spec). unitRosterMin is the separate A2 rule: a manager whose reports are predominantly clinical/frontline and whose span is at least this size is staffing a roster, not running a management span, and is exempt from thin/wide flagging entirely.
